_doc: One subject: shrink a fixed corpus with a single-file pure-Python codec. Bytes, lower is better; the codec's own source is part of the score.
name: compress
description: Make a fixed corpus as small as possible with a single-file, pure-Python codec. The score is bytes: every corpus file encoded, plus the size of codec.py itself, so carrying the corpus inside the decoder gains nothing and only modelling the data wins. Lower is better.
